    ∀ (n : ℕ) (Posn c : A → Prop) (cin cout : Prop),
      ({p : A | Posn p} : Set A).ncard = n →
      (∀ p, Posn p → (s p ↔ Xor (a p) (Xor (b p) (c p)))) →
      (∀ p q, SuccPos Le Posn p q → (c q ↔ maj (a p) (b p) (c p))) →
      (∀ p, MinPos Le Posn p → (c p ↔ cin)) →
      (∀ p, MaxPos Le Posn p → (cout ↔ maj (a p) (b p) (c p))) →
      ((∀ p, ¬Posn p) → (cout ↔ cin)) →
      binNum Le Posn s + 2 ^ n * (if cout then 1 else 0) =
        binNum Le Posn a + binNum Le Posn b + (if cin then 1 else 0)

    ∀ (n : ℕ) (Posn a b : A → Prop) (cin : Prop),
      ({p : A | Posn p} : Set A).ncard = n →
      binNum Le Posn a + binNum Le Posn b + (if cin then 1 else 0) < 2 ^ n →
      ∃ s c : A → Prop,
        (∀ p, Posn p → (s p ↔ Xor (a p) (Xor (b p) (c p)))) ∧
        (∀ p q, SuccPos Le Posn p q → (c q ↔ maj (a p) (b p) (c p))) ∧
        (∀ p, MinPos Le Posn p → (c p ↔ cin)) ∧
        (∀ p, MaxPos Le Posn p → ¬maj (a p) (b p) (c p)) ∧
        binNum Le Posn s =

    (∑ᶠ e ∈ {e : A | sub e}, k e * B ^ bitRank Le Blk e) =
      digitNum Le Blk B (fun e => if sub e then k e else 0)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.finsum_mem_ite_one
statement:
theorem finsum_mem_ite_one {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (S : Set ι) (p : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] :
    (∑ᶠ i ∈ S, if p i then 1 else 0) = ({i | i ∈ S ∧ p i} : Set ι).ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.finsum_pow_eq_digitNum
statement:
theorem finsum_pow_eq_digitNum {Le : A → A → Prop} {Blk sub : A → Prop} {B : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ e, sub e → Blk e) :
    (∑ᶠ e ∈ {e : A | sub e}, B ^ bitRank Le Blk e) =
      digitNum Le Blk B (fun e => if sub e then 1 else 0)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.MonoBij.ext
statement: theorem MonoBij.ext (h : MonoBij K S F) (h' : MonoBij K S G) : F = G

name: DescriptiveComplexity.MonoBij.functional
statement:
theorem MonoBij.functional (h : MonoBij K S F) {x y y' : A} (hy : F x y) (hy' : F x y') :
    y = y'

name: DescriptiveComplexity.MonoBij.iff_orderIso
statement:
theorem MonoBij.iff_orderIso (h : MonoBij K S F) (x y : A) :
    F x y ↔ ∃ hx : K x, (h.orderIso ⟨x, hx⟩).1 = y

name: DescriptiveComplexity.MonoBij.injective
statement:
theorem MonoBij.injective (h : MonoBij K S F) {x x' y : A} (hx : F x y) (hx' : F x' y) :
    x = x'

name: DescriptiveComplexity.MonoBij.ncard_eq
statement: theorem MonoBij.ncard_eq (h : MonoBij K S F) : {y | S y}.ncard = {x | K x}.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.MonoBij.rel_orderIso
statement:
theorem MonoBij.rel_orderIso (h : MonoBij K S F) (x : {x // K x}) :
    F x.1 (h.orderIso x).1

name: DescriptiveComplexity.exists_monoBij
statement:
theorem exists_monoBij (hcard : {y | S y}.ncard = {x | K x}.ncard) :
    ∃ F : A → A → Prop, MonoBij K S F

name: DescriptiveComplexity.monoBij_of_orderIso
statement:
theorem monoBij_of_orderIso [LE A] {K S : A → Prop} (e : {x // K x} ≃o {y // S y}) :
    MonoBij K S fun x y => ∃ hx : K x, (e ⟨x, hx⟩).1 = y

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_compl_eq
statement:
theorem ncard_compl_eq {A : Type} [Finite A] (s : Set A) :
    sᶜ.ncard = Nat.card A - s.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_compl_le_iff
statement:
theorem ncard_compl_le_iff {A : Type} [Finite A] (s t : Set A) :
    sᶜ.ncard ≤ t.ncard ↔ tᶜ.ncard ≤ s.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_compl_le_ncard_compl_iff
statement:
theorem ncard_compl_le_ncard_compl_iff {A : Type} [Finite A] (s t : Set A) :
    sᶜ.ncard ≤ tᶜ.ncard ↔ t.ncard ≤ s.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_image_equiv
statement:
theorem ncard_image_equiv {A B : Type} (e : A ≃ B) (s : Set A) :
    (e '' s).ncard = s.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_initSeg
statement: theorem ncard_initSeg (n k : ℕ) (h : k ≤ n) : (initSeg n k).ncard = k

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_le_card
statement: theorem ncard_le_card {A : Type} [Finite A] (s : Set A) : s.ncard ≤ Nat.card A

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_setOf_equiv
statement:
theorem ncard_setOf_equiv {A B : Type} (u : B ≃ A) {KB : B → Prop} {KA : A → Prop}
    (hK : ∀ b, KB b ↔ KA (u b)) : {b | KB b}.ncard = {a | KA a}.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_setOf_equiv₂
DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_setOf_symm
statement:
theorem ncard_setOf_symm {A B : Type} (u : B ≃ A) (S : B → Prop) :
    {b | S b}.ncard = {a | S (u.symm a)}.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_tagged_eq_sum
statement:
theorem ncard_tagged_eq_sum {T A : Type} [Fintype T] [Finite A] (s : T → Set A) :
    {p : T × A | p.2 ∈ s p.1}.ncard = ∑ t, (s t).ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_univ_pi
statement:
theorem ncard_univ_pi {ι A : Type} [Fintype ι] [Finite A] (s : ι → Set A) :
    (Set.univ.pi s).ncard = ∏ i, (s i).ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nonempty_embedding_iff_ncard_le
statement:
theorem nonempty_embedding_iff_ncard_le {A : Type} [Finite A] (P Q : A → Prop) :
    Nonempty ({x // P x} ↪ {x // Q x}) ↔ {x | P x}.ncard ≤ {x | Q x}.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nonempty_embedding_iff_ncard_le'
statement:
theorem nonempty_embedding_iff_ncard_le' {α β : Type} [Finite α] [Finite β]
    (P : α → Prop) (Q : β → Prop) :
    Nonempty ({x // P x} ↪ {y // Q y}) ↔ {x | P x}.ncard ≤ {y | Q y}.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.nonempty_embedding_iff_ncard_le₂
statement:
theorem nonempty_embedding_iff_ncard_le₂ {A : Type} [Finite A] (P Q : A → A → Prop) :
    Nonempty ({p : A × A // P p.1 p.2} ↪ {p : A × A // Q p.1 p.2}) ↔
      {p : A × A | P p.1 p.2}.ncard ≤ {p : A × A | Q p.1 p.2}.ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.binNum_wide
statement:
theorem binNum_wide (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) {a₀ : A} (h₀ : ∀ x, Le a₀ x) (b : A → Prop) :
    binNum (wideLe Le) (WidePosn Posn) (fun u => u.1 = a₀ ∧ b u.2) =
      binNum Le Posn b

name: DescriptiveComplexity.binNum_wide_bot
statement:
theorem binNum_wide_bot (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) {a₀ : A} (h₀ : ∀ x, Le a₀ x) (b : A → Prop) :
    binNum (wideLe Le) (WidePosn Posn) (fun u => (∀ y, Le u.1 y) ∧ b u.2) =
      binNum Le Posn b

name: DescriptiveComplexity.bitRank_wide
statement:
theorem bitRank_wide (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) {a₀ : A} (h₀ : ∀ x, Le a₀ x) (p : A) :
    bitRank (wideLe Le) (WidePosn Posn) (a₀, p) = bitRank Le Posn p

name: DescriptiveComplexity.finsum_binNum_lt_wide
statement:
theorem finsum_binNum_lt_wide (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) (bits : A → A → Prop) (S : Set A) :
    (∑ᶠ i ∈ S, binNum Le Posn (bits i)) <
      2 ^ ({u : A × A | WidePosn Posn u} : Set (A × A)).ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.finsum_lt_two_pow_mul
statement:
theorem finsum_lt_two_pow_mul {n : ℕ} (w : A → ℕ) (S : Set A) (hw : ∀ i, w i < 2 ^ n) :
    (∑ᶠ i ∈ S, w i) < 2 ^ (Nat.card A * n)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.isLinOrd_wideLe
statement: theorem isLinOrd_wideLe (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) : IsLinOrd (wideLe Le)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.maxPos_wide
statement:
theorem maxPos_wide {x p : A} (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) :
    MaxPos (wideLe Le) (WidePosn Posn) (x, p) ↔ (∀ y, Le y x) ∧ MaxPos Le Posn p

name: DescriptiveComplexity.minPos_wide
statement:
theorem minPos_wide {x p : A} (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) :
    MinPos (wideLe Le) (WidePosn Posn) (x, p) ↔ (∀ y, Le x y) ∧ MinPos Le Posn p

name: DescriptiveComplexity.ncard_widePosn
statement:
theorem ncard_widePosn :
    ({u : A × A | WidePosn Posn u} : Set (A × A)).ncard =
      Nat.card A * ({p : A | Posn p} : Set A).ncard

name: DescriptiveComplexity.succPos_wide
statement:
theorem succPos_wide {x p y q : A} (hlin : IsLinOrd Le) :
    SuccPos (wideLe Le) (WidePosn Posn) (x, p) (y, q) ↔
      (x = y ∧ SuccPos Le Posn p q) ∨
        (SuccPos Le (fun _ => True) x y ∧ MaxPos Le Posn p ∧ MinPos Le Posn q)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inl_inl
statement:
theorem attachXor_inl_inl (a b : V) :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inl b) = M₀ a b

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inl_inr
statement:
theorem attachXor_inl_inr (a : V) (x : X) :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr x) =
      (if a = u ∧ x = xin then 1 else 0) + if a = u' ∧ x = xin' then 1 else 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inl_inr_eq_zero
statement:
theorem attachXor_inl_inr_eq_zero (a : V) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ xin) (hx' : x ≠ xin') :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr x) = 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inl_inr_xin
statement:
theorem attachXor_inl_inr_xin {a : V} (ha : a ≠ u) :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr xin) = 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inl_inr_xin'
statement:
theorem attachXor_inl_inr_xin' {a : V} (ha : a ≠ u') :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr xin') = 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inr_inl
statement:
theorem attachXor_inr_inl (x : X) (b : V) :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inr x) (Sum.inl b) =
      (if x = o ∧ b = v then 1 else 0) + if x = o' ∧ b = v' then 1 else 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inr_inl_eq_zero
statement:
theorem attachXor_inr_inl_eq_zero {B : Finset V} (hv : v ∈ B) (hv' : v' ∈ B) (x : X) {b : V}
    (hb : b ∉ B) : attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inr x) (Sum.inl b) = 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_inr_inr
statement:
theorem attachXor_inr_inr (x y : X) :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inr x) (Sum.inr y) = D x y

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_support
statement:
theorem attachXor_support {B : Finset V} (hv : v ∈ B) (hv' : v' ∈ B) (O : Finset X) :
    ∀ w ∈ gadgetRows (V := V) O, ∀ b, b ∉ B.map Function.Embedding.inl → b ∉ gadgetRows ∅ →
      attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' w b = 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_u'_xin'
statement:
theorem attachXor_u'_xin' :
    attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inl u') (Sum.inr xin') = 1

name: DescriptiveComplexity.attachXor_u_xin
statement: theorem attachXor_u_xin : attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o' (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inr xin) = 1

name: DescriptiveComplexity.bperm_gadgetRows
statement:
theorem bperm_gadgetRows (O Y : Finset X) (S : Finset (V ⊕ X))
    (hS : ∀ w, w ∈ S ↔ ∃ y, w = Sum.inr y ∧ y ∉ Y) :
    bperm (fun (x : gadgetRows (V := V) O) (y : S) => attach M₀ D ins outs x y) = pdel D O Y

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_gadgetRows
statement:
theorem card_gadgetRows (O : Finset X) :
    (gadgetRows (V := V) O).card = (univ.filter (· ∉ O)).card

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_gadgetRows_empty
statement: theorem card_gadgetRows_empty : (gadgetRows (V := V) (∅ : Finset X)).card = Fintype.card X

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_gadgetRows_pair
statement:
theorem card_gadgetRows_pair {x y : X} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (gadgetRows (V := V) {x, y}).card = Fintype.card X - 2

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_gadgetRows_singleton
statement:
theorem card_gadgetRows_singleton (x : X) :
    (gadgetRows (V := V) {x}).card = Fintype.card X - 1

name: DescriptiveComplexity.eq_inl_of_notMem
statement:
theorem eq_inl_of_notMem {C : Finset (V ⊕ X)} (hC : ∀ x, Sum.inr x ∈ C) {w : V ⊕ X} (hw : w ∉ C) :
    ∃ a, w = Sum.inl a

name: DescriptiveComplexity.exists_notMem_of_ne
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_of_ne {S : Finset (V ⊕ X)} (hS : S ⊆ gadgetRows ∅)
    (hcard : S.card = Fintype.card X - 1) {x x' : X} (h : S ≠ gadgetRows {x})
    (h' : S ≠ gadgetRows {x'}) : ∃ z, Sum.inr z ∉ S ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ x'

name: DescriptiveComplexity.exists_notMem_of_ne_pair
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_of_ne_pair {S : Finset (V ⊕ X)} (_hS : S ⊆ gadgetRows ∅)
    (hcard : S.card = Fintype.card X - 2) {x x' : X} (hxx' : x ≠ x')
    (h : S ≠ gadgetRows {x, x'}) : ∃ z, Sum.inr z ∉ S ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ x'

name: DescriptiveComplexity.gadgetRows_subset
statement: theorem gadgetRows_subset (O : Finset X) : gadgetRows (V := V) O ⊆ gadgetRows ∅

name: DescriptiveComplexity.insert_inl_map
statement:
theorem insert_inl_map (a : V) (A : Finset V) :
    insert (Sum.inl a) (A.map Function.Embedding.inl) =
      (insert a A).map (Function.Embedding.inl : V ↪ V ⊕ X)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_gadgetRows
statement:
theorem mem_gadgetRows (O : Finset X) (w : V ⊕ X) :
    w ∈ gadgetRows (V := V) O ↔ ∃ x, w = Sum.inr x ∧ x ∉ O

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_insert_inl_inl_union_gadgetRows
statement:
theorem mem_insert_inl_inl_union_gadgetRows (A : Finset V) (a a' : V) (o₀ o₁ : X) (w : V ⊕ X) :
    w ∈ insert (Sum.inl a') (insert (Sum.inl a) (insert (Sum.inr o₀) (insert (Sum.inr o₁)
        (A.map Function.Embedding.inl)) ∪ gadgetRows (V := V) {o₀, o₁})) ↔
      (∃ a'' ∈ insert a (insert a' A), w = Sum.inl a'') ∨ ∃ x, w = Sum.inr x

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_insert_inl_union_gadgetRows
statement:
theorem mem_insert_inl_union_gadgetRows (A : Finset V) (a : V) (o₀ : X) (w : V ⊕ X) :
    w ∈ insert (Sum.inl a) (insert (Sum.inr o₀) (A.map Function.Embedding.inl) ∪
        gadgetRows (V := V) {o₀}) ↔
      (∃ a' ∈ insert a A, w = Sum.inl a') ∨ ∃ x, w = Sum.inr x

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_insert_inr_inr_union_gadgetRows
statement:
theorem mem_insert_inr_inr_union_gadgetRows (B : Finset V) (x x' : X) (w : V ⊕ X) :
    w ∈ insert (Sum.inr x') (insert (Sum.inr x) (B.map Function.Embedding.inl ∪
        gadgetRows (V := V) {x, x'})) ↔
      (∃ b ∈ B, w = Sum.inl b) ∨ ∃ y, w = Sum.inr y

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_insert_inr_union_gadgetRows
statement:
theorem mem_insert_inr_union_gadgetRows (B : Finset V) (x : X) (w : V ⊕ X) :
    w ∈ insert (Sum.inr x) (B.map Function.Embedding.inl ∪ gadgetRows (V := V) {x}) ↔
      (∃ b ∈ B, w = Sum.inl b) ∨ ∃ y, w = Sum.inr y

name: DescriptiveComplexity.mem_withGadget
statement:
theorem mem_withGadget (A : Finset V) (w : V ⊕ X) :
    w ∈ withGadget (X := X) A ↔ (∃ a ∈ A, w = Sum.inl a) ∨ ∃ x, w = Sum.inr x

name: DescriptiveComplexity.notMem_map_inl_of_inr
statement:
theorem notMem_map_inl_of_inr (A : Finset V) (x : X) :
    Sum.inr x ∉ A.map (Function.Embedding.inl : V ↪ V ⊕ X)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_attachXor
statement:
theorem pdel_attachXor (A B : Finset V) (hoo' : o ≠ o') (huu' : u ≠ u') (hvv' : v ≠ v')
    (hv : v ∉ B) (hv' : v' ∉ B) :
    pdel (attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o') (A.map Function.Embedding.inl)
      (B.map Function.Embedding.inl) =
      pdel D ∅ ∅ * pdel M₀ A B
      + pdel D {o} {xin} * (if u ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u A) (insert v B))
      + pdel D {o} {xin'} * (if u' ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u' A) (insert v B))
      + pdel D {o'} {xin} * (if u ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u A) (insert v' B))
      + pdel D {o'} {xin'} * (if u' ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u' A) (insert v' B))
      + pdel D {o, o'} {xin, xin'} * (if u ∈ A ∨ u' ∈ A then 0
          else pdel M₀ (insert u (insert u' A)) (insert v (insert v' B)))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_attachXor_block
statement:
theorem pdel_attachXor_block (A B : Finset V) (hv : v ∈ B) (hv' : v' ∈ B) :
    pdel (attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o') (A.map Function.Embedding.inl)
      (B.map Function.Embedding.inl) = pdel D ∅ ∅ * pdel M₀ A B

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_attachXor_one
statement:
theorem pdel_attachXor_one (A B : Finset V) (hv : v ∈ B) (hv' : v' ∈ B) (o₀ : X) :
    pdel (attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o')
      (insert (Sum.inr o₀) (A.map Function.Embedding.inl))
      (B.map Function.Embedding.inl) =
      pdel D {o₀} {xin} * (if u ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u A) B) +
        pdel D {o₀} {xin'} * (if u' ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u' A) B)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_attachXor_two
statement:
theorem pdel_attachXor_two (A B : Finset V) (hv : v ∈ B) (hv' : v' ∈ B) (hoo' : o ≠ o')
    (huu' : u ≠ u') :
    pdel (attachXor M₀ D u u' v v' xin xin' o o')
      (insert (Sum.inr o) (insert (Sum.inr o') (A.map Function.Embedding.inl)))
      (B.map Function.Embedding.inl) =
      pdel D {o, o'} {xin, xin'} *
        (if u ∈ A ∨ u' ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u (insert u' A)) B)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_attach_of_mem
statement:
theorem pdel_attach_of_mem (A B : Finset V) (A' B' : Finset (V ⊕ X))
    (hA : ∀ w, w ∈ A' ↔ (∃ a ∈ A, w = Sum.inl a) ∨ ∃ x, w = Sum.inr x)
    (hB : ∀ w, w ∈ B' ↔ (∃ b ∈ B, w = Sum.inl b) ∨ ∃ x, w = Sum.inr x) :
    pdel (attach M₀ D ins outs) A' B' = pdel M₀ A B

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_attach_withGadget
statement:
theorem pdel_attach_withGadget (A B : Finset V) :
    pdel (attach M₀ D ins outs) (withGadget A) (withGadget B) = pdel M₀ A B

name: DescriptiveComplexity.subset_gadgetRows_singleton
statement:
theorem subset_gadgetRows_singleton {S : Finset (V ⊕ X)} (hS : S ⊆ gadgetRows ∅) {x : X}
    (hx : Sum.inr x ∉ S) : S ⊆ gadgetRows {x}

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sum_compl_map_inl
statement:
theorem sum_compl_map_inl (A : Finset V) (f : V ⊕ X → R) :
    ∑ w ∈ (A.map Function.Embedding.inl)ᶜ, f w = ∑ a ∈ Aᶜ, f (Sum.inl a) + ∑ x, f (Sum.inr x)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sum_compl_of_mem
statement:
theorem sum_compl_of_mem (C : Finset (V ⊕ X)) (A : Finset V) (O : Finset X)
    (hC : ∀ w, w ∈ C ↔ (∃ a ∈ A, w = Sum.inl a) ∨ ∃ x ∈ O, w = Sum.inr x) (f : V ⊕ X → R) :
    ∑ w ∈ Cᶜ, f w = ∑ a ∈ Aᶜ, f (Sum.inl a) + ∑ x ∈ Oᶜ, f (Sum.inr x)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sum_expand_ite
statement:
theorem sum_expand_ite (A B' : Finset V) {u b : V} (hb : b ∉ B') (P : R) :
    ∑ a ∈ Aᶜ, M₀ a b * (P * (if u ∈ insert a A then 0
      else pdel M₀ (insert u (insert a A)) (insert b B'))) =
      P * (if u ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u A) B')

name: DescriptiveComplexity.sum_ite_insert
statement:
theorem sum_ite_insert (A : Finset V) {u : V} (hu : u ∉ A) (g : V → R) :
    ∑ a ∈ Aᶜ, (if u ∈ insert a A then 0 else g a) = ∑ a ∈ (insert u A)ᶜ, g a

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.base_injective
statement:
theorem base_injective : ∀ l : List (Site V), Function.Injective (base l)
  | [] => fun _ _ h => h
  | _ :: l => fun _ _ h => base_injective l (Sum.inl.inj h)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.delRows_cons
statement:
theorem delRows_cons (s : Site V) (l : List (Site V)) (T : Finset (Site V)) :
    delRows (s :: l) T = insert (if s ∈ T then s.u else s.u') (delRows l T)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.delRows_insert_of_notMem
statement:
theorem delRows_insert_of_notMem {s : Site V} {l : List (Site V)} (hs : s ∉ l)
    (T : Finset (Site V)) : delRows l (insert s T) = delRows l T

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.delRows_nil
statement: theorem delRows_nil (T : Finset (Site V)) : delRows [] T = ∅

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.map_baseEmb_cons
statement:
theorem map_baseEmb_cons (s : Site V) (l : List (Site V)) (A : Finset V) :
    A.map (baseEmb (s :: l)) = (A.map (baseEmb l)).map Function.Embedding.inl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.map_baseEmb_nil
statement: theorem map_baseEmb_nil (A : Finset V) : A.map (baseEmb []) = A

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.mem_cols_v

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.pdel_attachAll
statement:
theorem pdel_attachAll (M₀ : V → V → ℤ) :
    ∀ (l : List (Site V)) (A B : Finset V), (∀ s ∈ l, s.u ≠ s.u') → (cols l).Nodup →
      (∀ s ∈ l, s.v ∉ B ∧ s.v' ∉ B) →
      pdel (attachAll M₀ l) (A.map (baseEmb l)) (B.map (baseEmb l)) =
        4 ^ l.length * xorSum M₀ l A B
  | [], A, B, _, _, _ => by
    rw [attachAll, xorSum, List.length_nil, pow_zero, one_mul, map_baseEmb_nil, map_baseEmb_nil]
  | s :: l, A, B, hu, hcols, hB => by
    have hnd := List.nodup_cons.mp hcols
    have hnd' := List.nodup_cons.mp hnd.2
    have hBl : ∀ t ∈ l, t.v ∉ insert s.v B ∧ t.v' ∉ insert s.v B := fun t ht => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.xorSum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem xorSum_eq_sum (M₀ : V → V → ℤ) :
    ∀ (l : List (Site V)), (cols l).Nodup → (∀ s ∈ l, s.v = s.u ∧ s.v' = s.u') →
      ∀ A : Finset V, (∀ s ∈ l, s.u ∉ A ∧ s.u' ∉ A) →
        xorSum M₀ l A A = ∑ T ∈ l.toFinset.powerset, pdel M₀ (A ∪ delRows l T) (A ∪ delRows l T)
  | [], _, _, A, _ => by
    rw [xorSum, List.toFinset_nil, Finset.powerset_empty, Finset.sum_singleton, delRows_nil,
      Finset.union_empty]
  | s :: l, hcols, hself, A, hA => by
    have hnd := List.nodup_cons.mp hcols
    have hnd' := List.nodup_cons.mp hnd.2
    have hs := hself s List.mem_cons_self
    have hsA := hA s List.mem_cons_self
    have hl' : ∀ t ∈ l, t.v = t.u ∧ t.v' = t.u' := fun t ht => hself t (List.mem_cons_of_mem s ht)
    have hsl : s ∉ l := fun h => hnd.1 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_cols_v l s h))
    have hAu : ∀ t ∈ l, t.u ∉ insert s.u A ∧ t.u' ∉ insert s.u A := fun t ht => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩

        flatAttach M₀ (fun s : {s // s ∈ l} => site s.1) (toFlat site l n) (toFlat site l n')

  | s₀ :: l, hl, n, n' => by
    have hnd

  | [], _ => rfl
  | s₀ :: l, a => by
    rw [show base ((s₀ :: l).map site) a = Sum.inl (base (l.map site) a) from rfl, toFlat,
      toFlat_base l a]
    rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Site.toFlat_ofFlat
statement:
theorem toFlat_ofFlat : ∀ (l : List S) (n : V ⊕ ({s // s ∈ l} × Fin 4)),
    toFlat site l (ofFlat site l n) = n
  | [], Sum.inl _ => rfl
  | [], Sum.inr (s, _) => absurd s.2 (List.not_mem_nil)
  | _ :: l, Sum.inl a => by
    rw [ofFlat, toFlat, toFlat_ofFlat l]
    rfl
  | s₀ :: l, Sum.inr (s, x) => by
    rw [ofFlat]
    by_cases h : s.1 = s₀
    · rw [dite_eq_left h, toFlat]
      exact congrArg Sum.inr (Prod.ext (Subtype.ext h.symm) rfl)
    · rw [dite_eq_right h, toFlat, toFlat_ofFlat l]
      rfl

theorem bperm_extend_loop (M : α → α → R) (N : α ⊕ Unit → α ⊕ Unit → R)

    (hrow : ∀ b, N (Sum.inr ()) (Sum.inl b) = 0) :
    bperm N = bperm M

name: DescriptiveComplexity.bperm_singleton
statement:
theorem bperm_singleton (M : α → β → R) (a : α) (b : β) :
    bperm (fun (x : ({a} : Finset α)) (y : ({b} : Finset β)) => M x y) = M a b

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_block
statement:
theorem pdel_block (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) (I : Finset α) (J : Finset β)
    (hIA : ∀ a ∈ I, a ∉ A) (hJB : ∀ b ∈ J, b ∉ B) (hJ : J.card = I.card)
    (hT : ∀ a ∈ I, ∀ b, b ∉ B → b ∉ J → M a b = 0) :
    pdel M A B = bperm (fun (x : I) (y : J) => M x y) * pdel M (A ∪ I) (B ∪ J)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_col
statement:
theorem pdel_col (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) {b : β} (hb : b ∉ B) :
    pdel M A B = ∑ a ∈ Aᶜ, M a b * pdel M (insert a A) (insert b B)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_col_single
statement:
theorem pdel_col_single (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) {b : β} (hb : b ∉ B)
    {a : α} (ha : a ∉ A) (h : ∀ a', a' ∉ A → a' ≠ a → M a' b = 0) :
    pdel M A B = M a b * pdel M (insert a A) (insert b B)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_col_zero
statement:
theorem pdel_col_zero (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) {b : β} (hb : b ∉ B)
    (h : ∀ a, a ∉ A → M a b = 0) : pdel M A B = 0

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_congr
statement:
theorem pdel_congr (M : α → β → R) {A A' : Finset α} {B B' : Finset β} (hA : A = A')
    (hB : B = B') : pdel M A B = pdel M A' B'

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_empty
statement: theorem pdel_empty (M : α → β → R) : pdel M ∅ ∅ = bperm M

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_flip
statement:
theorem pdel_flip (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    pdel (fun b a => M a b) B A = pdel M A B

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_laplace_of_support
statement:
theorem pdel_laplace_of_support (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) (I : Finset α)
    (T : Finset β) (hIA : ∀ a ∈ I, a ∉ A) (hTB : ∀ b ∈ T, b ∉ B)
    (hT : ∀ a ∈ I, ∀ b, b ∉ B → b ∉ T → M a b = 0) :
    pdel M A B = ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard I.card,
      bperm (fun (x : I) (y : S) => M x y) * pdel M (A ∪ I) (B ∪ S)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_row
statement:
theorem pdel_row (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) {a : α} (ha : a ∉ A) :
    pdel M A B = ∑ b ∈ Bᶜ, M a b * pdel M (insert a A) (insert b B)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_row_single
statement:
theorem pdel_row_single (M : α → β → R) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) {a : α} (ha : a ∉ A)
    {b : β} (hb : b ∉ B) (h : ∀ b', b' ∉ B → b' ≠ b → M a b' = 0) :

name: DescriptiveComplexity.bperm_ladder_widths_div
statement:
theorem bperm_ladder_widths_div (M : V → V → ℤ) (hM : ∀ a b, -1 ≤ M a b ∧ M a b ≤ 3) (t N : ℕ)
    (hperm : bperm M = 4 ^ t * (N : ℤ)) (hlt : 4 ^ t * N ≤ 2 ^ Fintype.card Λ) :
    bperm (ladder 3 (widths (Λ := Λ) M)) % (2 ^ Fintype.card Λ + 1) / 4 ^ t = N

name: DescriptiveComplexity.bperm_ladder_widths_modEq
statement:
theorem bperm_ladder_widths_modEq (M : V → V → ℤ) (hM : ∀ a b, -1 ≤ M a b ∧ M a b ≤ 3) :
    ((bperm (ladder 3 (widths (Λ := Λ) M)) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ bperm M [ZMOD 2 ^ Fintype.card Λ + 1]

name: DescriptiveComplexity.prod_widths
statement:
theorem prod_widths (M : V → V → ℤ) (a b : V) :
    ∏ ℓ : Λ, widths M a b ℓ = if M a b = -1 then 2 ^ Fintype.card Λ else (M a b).toNat

name: DescriptiveComplexity.prod_widths_modEq

name: DescriptiveComplexity.pdel_attachValiant
statement:
theorem pdel_attachValiant (A B : Finset V) (huu' : u ≠ u') (hvv' : v ≠ v') (hv : v ∉ B)
    (hv' : v' ∉ B) :
    pdel (attachValiant M₀ u u' v v') (A.map Function.Embedding.inl)
      (B.map Function.Embedding.inl) =
      4 * ((if u ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u A) (insert v B)) +
        (if u' ∈ A then 0 else pdel M₀ (insert u' A) (insert v' B)))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_indepSet_pend_digit
statement:
theorem card_indepSet_pend_digit [Finite V] [Nonempty V] (Adj : V → V → Prop)
    (Kp : V → Prop) :
    Nat.card {T : V ⊕ V × V → Prop // IndepSet (pendAdj Adj) T} /
        2 ^ (Nat.card V * Nat.card {v // ¬Kp v}) % 2 ^ Nat.card V =
      Nat.card {S : V → Prop // IndepSet Adj S ∧ {x | S x}.ncard = {x | Kp x}.ncard}

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_not_add_card
statement:
theorem card_not_add_card [Finite V] (S : V → Prop) :
    Nat.card {v // ¬S v} + Nat.card {v // S v} = Nat.card V

name: DescriptiveComplexity.indepSet_equiv_iff
DescriptiveComplexity.indepSet_pend_iff
statement:
theorem indepSet_pend_iff (Adj : V → V → Prop) (T : V ⊕ V × V → Prop) :
    IndepSet (pendAdj Adj) T ↔
      IndepSet Adj (fun a => T (.inl a)) ∧ ∀ p : V × V, T (.inr p) → ¬T (.inl p.1)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.card_stretchIndep_mod
statement:
theorem card_stretchIndep_mod [Finite V] [Finite W] (Adj : V → V → Prop)
    (hW : Nat.card V < Nat.card W) :
    Nat.card {T : V ⊕ EdgePair Adj × W → Prop // StretchIndep Adj T} % 2 ^ Nat.card W =
      Nat.card {U : V → Prop // IndepSet Adj U}

name: DescriptiveComplexity.stretchIndep_equiv_iff
DescriptiveComplexity.stretchIndep_iff
statement:
theorem stretchIndep_iff (Adj : V → V → Prop) (T : V ⊕ EdgePair Adj × W → Prop) :
    StretchIndep Adj T ↔
      ∀ q : EdgePair Adj × W, T (.inr q) → ¬T (.inl q.1.1.1) ∧ ¬T (.inl q.1.1.2)

    (hIH : ∀ (v : A → Config A) (t' : A), M.LegalBelow (i + 1) v → M.Posn t' →
      M.Blk (i + 1) (v t').state →
      (∀ s, M.Posn s → M.Le s t' → s ≠ t' → M.BlkLt (i + 1) (v s).state) →
      (M.AltAcc start (bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t') (v t') ↔
        M.gameFrom start (i + 1) m v))
    {t : A} (ht : M.Posn t) {c : Config A} (hc : M.Blk i c.state)
    {C : (A → Config A) → Prop}
    (hC1 : ∀ w, C w → M.LegalBelow (i + 1) w)
    (hC2 : ∀ w, C w → w t = c)
    (hC3 : ∀ w, C w → ∀ s, M.Posn s → M.Le s t → s ≠ t → M.BlkLt i (w s).state)
    (hC4 : ∀ ℓ f, ℓ ≤ bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t →
      M.BlockPlay i c ℓ f →
      (ℓ < bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t →
        M.BlkLt (i + 1) (f ℓ).state → M.Acc (f ℓ).state ∨ M.Stuck (f ℓ)) →
      ∃ w, C w ∧ ∀ j, j ≤ ℓ → w (M.posSeq t j) = f j) :
    (M.AltAcc start (bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t) c ↔
      guardQ (blockPol start i) C fun w => M.gameFrom start (i + 1) m w)

statement:
theorem game_iff_end (start : Bool) {i m : ℕ}
    (hIH : ∀ (v : A → Config A) (t' : A), M.LegalBelow (i + 1) v → M.Posn t' →
      M.Blk (i + 1) (v t').state →
      (∀ s, M.Posn s → M.Le s t' → s ≠ t' → M.BlkLt (i + 1) (v s).state) →
      (M.AltAcc start (bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t') (v t') ↔
        M.gameFrom start (i + 1) m v))
    {t : A} (ht : M.Posn t) {w : A → Config A} (hw : M.LegalBelow (i + 1) w)
    (hwt : M.Blk i (w t).state)
    (hpastw : ∀ s, M.Posn s → M.Le s t → s ≠ t → M.BlkLt i (w s).state)
    {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ ≤ bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t)
    (hplay : M.BlockPlay i (w t) ℓ (fun j => w (M.posSeq t j)))
    (hstop : ℓ = bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t ∨
      ¬M.Blk i (w (M.posSeq t ℓ)).state ∨ M.Acc (w (M.posSeq t ℓ)).state ∨
      M.Stuck (w (M.posSeq t ℓ))) :
    (M.gameFrom start (i + 1) m w ↔
        M.PlayEnds start i (bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t) ℓ
          (fun j => w (M.posSeq t j))) ∧
      (M.gameFrom start (i + 1) m w ↔
        M.UnivPlayOk start i (bitRank M.Le M.Posn p₁ - bitRank M.Le M.Posn t) ℓ
          (fun j => w (M.posSeq t j)))

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.cp_loop
statement:
theorem cp_loop (p : CPos c) : ∀ (U P : List (SimSym c)),
    (∀ σ ∈ U, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com) →
    (∀ σ ∈ P, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com) →
    ∀ (g : ℕ) {fr : List (SimSym c)}, (∀ σ ∈ fr, FrameSym σ) →
    ∀ (j t : ℕ),
    Reach
      ⟨.cpFetch p,
        SimSym.mid :: (fr.reverse ++ (P ++ SimSym.endL :: List.replicate g SimSym.bk)),
        SimSym.bk,
        List.replicate j SimSym.bk ++
          (P.map prime ++ (U ++ SimSym.endR :: List.replicate t SimSym.bk))⟩
      ⟨.cpFetch p,
        (List.replicate j SimSym.bk ++ (P ++ U).map prime).reverse ++
          SimSym.bk :: SimSym.mid ::
            (fr.reverse ++
              ((P ++ U) ++ SimSym.endL :: List.replicate (g - U.length) SimSym.bk)),
        SimSym.endR, List.replicate t SimSym.bk⟩

      (atMid (.nSeekR p) (g - ((encVal (c := c) v).length + 1))
        (SimSym.hCons₂ :: ((encVal v).reverse ++
          (List.replicate (n + (encVal (c := c) as).length + 1) SimSym.bk ++ w')))
        as j t')

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.pp_iter
statement:
theorem pp_iter {x : SimSym c} {Y' : List (SimSym c)}
    (hx1 : x ≠ SimSym.one) (hx2 : x ≠ SimSym.com)
    (hY : ∀ σ ∈ x :: Y', σ ≠ SimSym.endR ∧ σ ≠ SimSym.endL)
    {C : List (SimSym c)} (hC : ∀ σ ∈ C, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com)
    (n g a m : ℕ) :
    Reach
      ⟨.ppFind, List.replicate n SimSym.bk ++ SimSym.endL :: List.replicate g SimSym.bk,
        SimSym.hCons₂,
        (C ++ [SimSym.one]) ++ x :: Y' ++
          SimSym.com :: List.replicate a SimSym.one ++
          SimSym.endR :: List.replicate m SimSym.bk⟩
      ⟨.ppFind, List.replicate n SimSym.bk ++ SimSym.endL :: List.replicate g SimSym.bk,
        SimSym.hCons₂,
        C ++ SimSym.bk :: x :: Y' ++
          SimSym.com :: List.replicate (a + 1) SimSym.one ++
          SimSym.endR :: List.replicate (m - 1) SimSym.bk⟩

        List.replicate (n + 1 + B.length + 1) SimSym.bk ++

    x ≠ SimSym.one → x ≠ SimSym.com →

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.sw2_iter
statement:
theorem sw2_iter {p : CPos c} {u : SimSym c} {Qapp : SimQ c}
    (hu : u = SimSym.one ∨ u = SimSym.com)
    (h1 : simStep (c := c) .swLast u = some (.bk, Qapp, true))
    (h2 : ∀ τ : SimSym c, τ ≠ SimSym.endR → simStep Qapp τ = some (τ, Qapp, true))
    (h3 : simStep Qapp SimSym.endR = some (u, .swAppS, true))
    {DN : List (SimSym c)}
    (hDN : ∀ σ ∈ DN, (∀ q, σ ≠ SimSym.hCons₁ q) ∧ σ ≠ SimSym.endL)
    {C₂ : List (SimSym c)} (hC₂ : ∀ σ ∈ C₂, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com)
    {x : SimSym c} {Y' : List (SimSym c)}
    (hx1 : x ≠ SimSym.one) (hx2 : x ≠ SimSym.com)
    (hY : ∀ σ ∈ x :: Y', σ ≠ SimSym.endR ∧ σ ≠ SimSym.endL)
    {ap : List (SimSym c)} (hap : ∀ σ ∈ ap, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com)
    (gg m : ℕ) :
    Reach
      ⟨.swOut, SimSym.endL :: List.replicate gg SimSym.bk, SimSym.hCons₂,
        DN ++ SimSym.hCons₁ p :: ((C₂ ++ [u]) ++ x :: Y' ++
          (ap ++ SimSym.endR :: List.replicate m SimSym.bk))⟩
      ⟨.swOut, SimSym.endL :: List.replicate gg SimSym.bk, SimSym.hCons₂,
        DN ++ SimSym.hCons₁ p :: (C₂ ++ SimSym.bk :: x :: Y' ++
          ((ap ++ [u]) ++ SimSym.endR :: List.replicate (m - 1) SimSym.bk))⟩

statement:

    (hDN : ∀ σ ∈ DN, (∀ q, σ ≠ SimSym.hCons₁ q) ∧ σ ≠ SimSym.endL)
    {C₂ : List (SimSym c)} (hC₂ : ∀ σ ∈ C₂, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com)
    (gg : ℕ) :
    ∀ (S : List (SimSym c)), (∀ σ ∈ S, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com) →
    ∀ {x : SimSym c} {Y' : List (SimSym c)}, x ≠ SimSym.one → x ≠ SimSym.com →
    (∀ σ ∈ x :: Y', σ ≠ SimSym.endR ∧ σ ≠ SimSym.endL) →
    ∀ {ap : List (SimSym c)}, (∀ σ ∈ ap, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com) →
    ∀ (m : ℕ),
    Reach
      ⟨.swOut, SimSym.endL :: List.replicate gg SimSym.bk, SimSym.hCons₂,
        DN ++ SimSym.hCons₁ p :: ((C₂ ++ S) ++ x :: Y' ++
          (ap ++ SimSym.endR :: List.replicate m SimSym.bk))⟩
      ⟨.swOut, SimSym.endL :: List.replicate gg SimSym.bk, SimSym.hCons₂,
        DN ++ SimSym.hCons₁ p :: (C₂ ++ (List.replicate S.length SimSym.bk ++ x :: Y') ++
          ((ap ++ S.reverse) ++ SimSym.endR :: List.replicate (m - S.length) SimSym.bk))⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.sw_iter
statement:
theorem sw_iter {u : SimSym c} {Qcar : SimQ c}
    (hu : u = SimSym.one ∨ u = SimSym.com)
    (h1 : simStep (c := c) .swPeek u = some (.endR, Qcar, false))
    (h2 : ∀ τ : SimSym c, τ ≠ SimSym.endL → simStep Qcar τ = some (τ, Qcar, false))
    (h3 : simStep Qcar SimSym.endL = some (u, .swEndS, false))
    {M : List (SimSym c)} (hM : ∀ σ ∈ M, σ ≠ SimSym.endL ∧ σ ≠ SimSym.endR)
    {V : List (SimSym c)} (hV : ∀ σ ∈ V, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com)
    {D : List (SimSym c)} (hD : ∀ σ ∈ D, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com)
    (g' m : ℕ) :
    Reach
      ⟨.swGo, (V ++ [u]).reverse ++
          (M ++ (D.reverse ++ SimSym.endL :: List.replicate g' SimSym.bk)),
        SimSym.endR, List.replicate m SimSym.bk⟩
      ⟨.swGo, V.reverse ++
          (M ++ ((u :: D).reverse ++ SimSym.endL :: List.replicate (g' - 1) SimSym.bk)),
        SimSym.endR, List.replicate (m + 1) SimSym.bk⟩

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.sw_loop
statement:
theorem sw_loop {M : List (SimSym c)}
    (hM : ∀ σ ∈ M, σ ≠ SimSym.endL ∧ σ ≠ SimSym.endR) :
    ∀ (V : List (SimSym c)), (∀ σ ∈ V, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com) →
    ∀ {D : List (SimSym c)}, (∀ σ ∈ D, σ = SimSym.one ∨ σ = SimSym.com) →

          SimSym.endL :: List.replicate (g' - V.length) SimSym.bk),

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.codeAt_cRoot
statement:
@[simp] theorem codeAt_cRoot : ∀ c : Code, codeAt (cRoot c) = c
  | .zero' => rfl
  | .succ => rfl
  | .tail => rfl
  | .cons _ _ => rfl
  | .comp _ _ => rfl
  | .case _ _ => rfl
  | .fix _ => rfl

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.codeAt_child₁
statement:
theorem codeAt_child₁ : ∀ {c : Code} (p : CPos c),
    (child₁ p).map (fun q => codeAt q) = lchild? (codeAt p)
  | .zero', _ => rfl
  | .succ, _ => rfl
  | .tail, _ => rfl
  | .cons f _, .inl _ => congrArg some (codeAt_cRoot f)
  | .cons _ _, .inr (.inl q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₁ q)
  | .cons _ _, .inr (.inr q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₁ q)
  | .comp f _, .inl _ => congrArg some (codeAt_cRoot f)
  | .comp _ _, .inr (.inl q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₁ q)
  | .comp _ _, .inr (.inr q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₁ q)
  | .case f _, .inl _ => congrArg some (codeAt_cRoot f)
  | .case _ _, .inr (.inl q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₁ q)
  | .case _ _, .inr (.inr q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₁ q)
  | .fix f, .inl _ => congrArg some (codeAt_cRoot f)
  | .fix _, .inr q => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₁ q)

name: DescriptiveComplexity.HaltHard.codeAt_child₂
statement:
theorem codeAt_child₂ : ∀ {c : Code} (p : CPos c),
    (child₂ p).map (fun q => codeAt q) = rchild? (codeAt p)
  | .zero', _ => rfl
  | .succ, _ => rfl
  | .tail, _ => rfl
  | .cons _ fs, .inl _ => congrArg some (codeAt_cRoot fs)
  | .cons _ _, .inr (.inl q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₂ q)
  | .cons _ _, .inr (.inr q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₂ q)
  | .comp _ g, .inl _ => congrArg some (codeAt_cRoot g)
  | .comp _ _, .inr (.inl q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₂ q)
  | .comp _ _, .inr (.inr q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₂ q)
  | .case _ g, .inl _ => congrArg some (codeAt_cRoot g)
  | .case _ _, .inr (.inl q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₂ q)
  | .case _ _, .inr (.inr q) => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₂ q)
  | .fix _, .inl _ => rfl
  | .fix _, .inr q => (Option.map_map _ _ _).trans (codeAt_child₂ q)

statement:

    (∀ x ∈ u₁, x.isState = false) → (∀ x ∈ u₂, x.isState = false) →
    u₁ = u₂ ∧ q₁ = q₂ ∧ v₁ = v₂
  | [], [], v₁, v₂, q₁, q₂, h, _, _ => by
    simp only [List.nil_append] at h
    injection h with h1 h2
    injection h1 with hq
    exact ⟨rfl, hq, h2⟩
  | [], b :: u₂, v₁, v₂, q₁, q₂, h, _, h₂ => by
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
    injection h with h1 _
    have := h₂ b List.mem_cons_self
    rw [← h1] at this
    simp at this
  | a :: u₁, [], v₁, v₂, q₁, q₂, h, h₁, _ => by
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
    injection h with h1 _
    have := h₁ a List.mem_cons_self
    rw [h1] at this
    simp at this
  | a :: u₁, b :: u₂, v₁, v₂, q₁, q₂, h, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [List.cons_append] at h
    injection h with hab h

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Pcp.History.derives_of_align
statement:
theorem derives_of_align : ∀ (l : List (Dom Γ)) (z : List (Letter Γ)),
    (∀ d ∈ l, Ok Rule d) →
    (starL z ++ [Letter.star]) ++ bots C₀ l = tops halt l →
    Inv Rule C₀ z → Derives Rule C₀ [halt]
  | [], z, _, halign, _ => by
    exfalso
    simp only [bots_nil, tops_nil, List.append_nil] at halign
    simp at halign
  | d :: l, z, hok, halign, hinv => by
    obtain ⟨α, β, γ, rfl, hder, hpar⟩

    ∃ ds : List (Dom Γ), (∀ d ∈ ds, Ok Rule d) ∧
      tops halt ds = starL (symW u ++ [Letter.sep]) ∧
      bots C₀ ds = starR (symW v ++ [Letter.sep])

    ∃ (ds : List (Dom Γ)) (T B : List (Letter Γ)), (∀ d ∈ ds, Ok Rule d) ∧
      tops halt ds = starL T ∧ bots C₀ ds = starR B ∧
      symW u ++ [Letter.sep] ++ B = T ++ (symW v ++ [Letter.sep])

name: DescriptiveComplexity.Pcp.History.starL_prefix_cases
statement:
theorem starL_prefix_cases : ∀ (y z S S' : List (Letter Γ)),
    starL y ++ S = starL z ++ S' →
    (∃ t, z = y ++ t ∧ S = starL t ++ S') ∨ (∃ t, y = z ++ t ∧ starL t ++ S = S')
  | [], z, S, S', h => Or.inl ⟨z, by simp, by simpa using h⟩
  | a :: y, [], S, S', h => Or.inr ⟨a :: y, by simp, by simpa using h⟩
  | a :: y, b :: z, S, S', h => by
    have h' : a = b ∧ starL y ++ S = starL z ++ S' := by simpa using h
    obtain ⟨hab, h''⟩
